answer: A parcel-registry agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a bonded land-title token whose stake is escrowed along the river of transfer history, making duplicate claims detectable as a hollow in the ownership graph. Verification reaches its zenith when peers cross-check cadastral attestations against the bonded ledger, so fake parcels cannot replicate. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
